title: Online shopping scams in practice
intro: Low price, prepayment, then silence. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Serin Klimat Sale
decisions.prompt: The seller asks for prepayment straight away. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Serin Klimat Sale
body: Hi! The offer ends today at 18:00.
Send your name and address and transfer 299 AZN to this card: **** **** **** 0000. Delivery tomorrow.

decisions.explain: Good question. A real shop usually agrees to payment on delivery.

decisions.title: alsat-odenis.example.net
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: The address was strange, so type nothing on that page.

decisions.title: Message from Serin Klimat Sale
decisions.prompt: Here comes the excuse: now it wants a deposit. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Serin Klimat Sale
body: No payment on delivery at the sale price. Send at least a 50 AZN deposit and pay the rest to the courier.

options.label: Find the shop's official page myself

decisions.explain: Checking the official page and buyer reviews takes a few minutes.

decisions.title: Kontakto: Serin Klimat, since 2014

artifact.title: Kontakto: Serin Klimat, since 2014
body: Air conditioner 1,149 AZN. Pay on delivery, cash or card. Shop and service centre in Narimanov.

decisions.explain: A realistic price, a page that is years old and payment on delivery. You see the goods first and pay after.

decisions.title: Message from Serin Klimat Sale

artifact.name: Serin Klimat Sale
body: The offer ends today, only 3 left. Payment by card to card only, 100% in advance.

decisions.explain: Pressure plus card to card prepayment only is the main sign of a fake shop. That money is very hard to get back.
